run.title: Composition Root, Ports, and Typed Results for apps/steme

commit.subject: feat(steme): add FileSystemPort and ImportGraphPort with Result-wrapped adapters
commit.body:
Add @steme-lab/result as a dependency and introduce the two ports this app's
composition root will need: FileSystemPort (shared, core/ports/) wrapping
node:fs reads/writes as Result plus a plain exists() boolean, and
ImportGraphPort (core/modules/audit/ports/) wrapping the existing, unchanged
buildImportGraph as Result instead of a thrower. Concrete adapters
(node-file-system-adapter, import-graph-adapter) are fully unit-tested against
real files/dirs. Nothing is wired into cli/ yet.

commit.subject: refactor(steme): return Result from parseRulepack instead of a hand-rolled union
commit.body:
Replace ParseRulepackResult's ad-hoc {ok:true,rulepack}|{ok:false,errors}
union with @steme-lab/result's Result<Rulepack, ConfigError[]>. Pure type and
call-site rename — no change to what a rulepack must look like to parse, or
to any ConfigError message.

commit.subject: refactor(steme): route audit through a composition root and capability, fixing self-audit
commit.body:
apps/steme was violating its own shipped rulepack (TS_BOUNDARY_007:
cli/audit-pipeline.ts imported adapters/index.ts directly). Fix it the way
the tool requires of every other app: core/composition/index.ts becomes the
only file allowed to reach adapters/ (wiring FileSystemPort and
ImportGraphPort from phase-01), core/modules/audit/capability.ts exposes a
Result-returning computeAudit that cli consumes instead of adapters/
directly, and cli/audit-pipeline.ts is deleted. program.ts and
governance.ts's shared computeAudit call site now branches on Result instead
of catching a thrown AuditPipelineError, with every existing message and
exit code preserved byte-for-byte. A new self-audit E2E test makes "steme
audit apps/steme exits 0" a permanent regression check, and a new fixture
case proves the boundary rules still fire correctly elsewhere.

phases.title: Composition root and the audit capability

commit.subject: refactor(steme): route baseline I/O through FileSystemPort and a governance capability
commit.body:
Move program.ts's and commands/governance.ts's direct readFileSync /
writeFileSync / existsSync calls for the baseline register behind
core/modules/governance/capability.ts, built on the same FileSystemPort as
the audit capability. parseBaseline now returns Result<Baseline,
ConfigError[]> for consistency with parseRulepack (phase-02) — a type change
only, no change to what a baseline file must look like. Every existing exit
code, stderr message, and baseline-lifecycle E2E scenario is unchanged; cli/
now contains zero direct node:fs calls anywhere in apps/steme.

phases.title: Governance capability and FileSystemPort for baseline I/O
